To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have collected and made available a corpus that provides a rich and diverse set of natural language instructions to a robot in a search and navigation task.

(1) the corpus is useful in studying how human language can be grounded into robot action and how robot action can be communicated back to the human; (2) the corpus can be used to explore how human and robot can work together to achieve a common task, such as search; (3) the corpus can provide insight into how humans communicate with robots, especially in the context of a remote collaboration
we have collected a corpus of human-robot dialogues that can be used to explore the translation and interpretation of human natural language instructions to actions executable by a physical robot.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of human-robot interaction technologies that facilitate collaboration between a human and a remotely controlled robot.
the design and implementation of a system that enables a human to interact with a robot to accomplish a task.
how humans and robots collaborate in a search and navigation task and what this collaboration looks like in natural language.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the corpus data is a valuable resource for researchers and developers working on the intersection of human-robot dialogue and collaboration, and natural language understanding.
the corpus provides insight into how humans and robots can work together, in the context of a search and navigation task, to accomplish a shared goal.
the corpus data is a useful resource for researchers interested in the study of grounding natural language instructions into robot actions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this corpus provides a rich and diverse dataset of human-robot dialogue in search and navigation tasks.
the corpus can be useful to explore and evaluate the grounding of natural language instructions to robot actions.
we are providing a corpus that is grounded in the physical world and that can be used to explore and test action models and their grounding in natural language instructions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the corpus provides an important resource for understanding and developing models that can be used to connect natural language instructions to robot action.
a human’s ability to instruct a robot to accomplish a task is limited by the robot’s ability to execute a task in a particular environment.
natural language can serve as a powerful tool to facilitate human-robot interaction and collaboration.
